lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: Master,

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: I prepared something a bit different today.
You being dressed as a maid is already plenty unique.

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: Is it, though?

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: Aside from a change of outfit and tying my hair up,

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: it's not all that different.
As they say, the clothes make the man.

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: Hehe,

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: Oh, but this time,

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: we'll be doing things a little differently.

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: Why don't you put this on for me?
What do you mean by "doing things differently"?

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: This time,

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: I'll be the customer,

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: and you'll be the maid.
Do we really need to change our clothes for that?
Besides, wouldn't it be more appropriate for me to be a butler?

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: Honestly, it doesn't matter all that much.

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: I'm just interested in having you

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: do all the things I usually do for you.
Like what?

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: Like giving me a pat on the shoulder,

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: accompanying me as I take my starfish for a walk,

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: or backing me up whenever I fake being sick.

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: You know, stuff like that.
... You've never done any of those things for me.

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: Ugh, whatever!

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: Just do it, pleaaaaaasseeeee?!
I can do everything you asked, except for that last one.

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: No way! It's a package deal.

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: If I nix that one, the other two are a no-go as well.
Why do we have to do this today, anyway? Can't we do it another time?

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: No, it has to be today.

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: Otherwise, Helm is gonna make sure I'm sleeping with the fishes.

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: It was an honor to serve you, Master.

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: I hope you can find peace once I'm gone.
Hahaha. Why did you fake being sick in the first place anyway?

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: Because I wanted some free time

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: to do the other two things with you, Master.
Hmm...

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: It's fine, Master.

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: Trony's already taught me how to write a will.
Let me know when you have time, and we can do some of those things together.

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: Okay!
